personality: 3 Editorial structure with 1 iOS-Native Clean utility
personality_one_liner: Warm, premium, photo-led real estate marketplace with editorial elegance and ink-black tactility.

typography_adjustments.editorial_usage: Use lowercase DM Serif Display exclusively for expressive large bottom sheet headlines and onboarding primary questions. Everything else uses Plus Jakarta Sans.
typography_adjustments.weight_restrictions: Cap font weight at 500. Use typography scale instead of heavy weights to establish hierarchy. Bolder variants from the old theme should map to 500, tighter tracking for headers.
typography_adjustments.serif_usage: Keep DM Serif Display ONLY for 'premium' touchpoints: onboarding hero text, massive numeric stats (wallet balance), and bottom sheet expressive titles.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Off-white canvas acts as a breathing frame around soft grey cards. Minimum md (12pt) padding inside cards, xl (24pt) between distinct sections.

component_treatments.buttons: Primary buttons are pill radius (999), Ink Black (primary) background, white text. Secondary/ghost buttons use surfaceAlt or transparent.
component_treatments.chips: Soft-grey (surfaceAlt) background, ink text (textSecondary). Selected state is Ink Black (primary) background with white text.
component_treatments.photo_led_cards: Image is on the left (rounded square) OR full-bleed cover with vertical scrim (transparent to 70% black). Bold Plus Jakarta title. Small context line. Avatar stack + 'N saves' bottom aligned.
component_treatments.bottom_sheets: White (bgElevated) background, generous 28-32pt top radii. Visible handle. Expressive lowercase editorial headline (DM Serif). Pill CTA + subtle text link ('maybe later').
component_treatments.map_markers: Selected/Saved/Friends: Circular photo markers with thin white border. Default/Unselected: simple pill with bold price/label in primary (black).
component_treatments.floating_filters: Floating pill row docked at the bottom or top of the map. Blur/glass container with soft-grey chips inside.
component_treatments.tab_bar: Floating pill or edge-to-edge glass container. Ink Black active state icons, textSecondary inactive. No borders.
component_treatments.skeletons: Use skeleton (soft grey) and skeletonHighlight. Do not use generic spinners for cards.

motion_spec.stagger: List and card grids enter with a 50ms stagger per item.
motion_spec.press_scale: 0.97 scale on Cards and Pill buttons. 0.93 for smaller icon buttons.
motion_spec.pops: Heart (save) and Add actions get a quick overshoot spring (tension 200, friction 10).
motion_spec.sheets: iOS native-feeling spring for bottom sheets. Gentle, non-bouncy settling.
motion_spec.reduced_motion: Fallback to opacity cross-fades (150ms) for all structural layout shifts and sheet presentations.

onboarding_blueprint.imagery: Use ONLY real listing photos from the property API, the AMASS emblem, and FIXA logo. No unbranded stock.
onboarding_blueprint.layout: Large editorial headline (lowercase DM Serif). Full-width black pill buttons stacked for single-choice questions. Selectable interest/housing-preference tiles in a grid.
onboarding_blueprint.actions: Blue-to-violet gradient pill (premium token) CTA for completion/premium gates, otherwise primary Ink Black pill.

instructions_to_main_agent: Reskin the UI strictly using the provided lightTheme and darkTheme hex maps directly into your theme.ts override.
No generic indigo/purple unless specifically tied to the 'premium' token gradient CTA.
Base background must be off-white (bg: #F7F6F3), cards must be soft-grey (surfaceAlt: #EAE8E3) or white for contrast.
Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans up to 500 weight. DM Serif Display ONLY for expressive large headers and wallet balances.
Convert all primary CTAs to Ink Black (primary: #111111 in light mode) fully rounded pill buttons.
